description.value:
Frequency once per round

Requirements You're adjacent to a creature, hazard, or item that has the glitching condition.

You know how to manipulate errors in high-tech programming and complex machinery, enhancing or mitigating the resulting glitches. You can either increase or reduce the value of the required target's glitching condition by 1.

Special If you have the repair SRO heritage, you can use Manipulate Glitch on a target up to 30 feet away.
